optional-spread: Pass an optional command field with a spread, and omit the property when the value is undefined.
insert-many: Copy the insertMany line from the seed file. The cast is already on that line. Do not copy the seed into a handler or a read repository.
get-new-item: Append a collection entry with getNewItem(), then assign its fields. Do not call addItem with a plain object.
status-409: Throw Object.assign(new Error('...'), { status: 409 }) for a duplicate. Do not replace that status with 400.
status-400: A bad value throws status 400. Change minLength, maxLength, or pattern on the existing VOString. The class body stays empty.
status-404: A missing id throws status 404. The route returns that status.
vo-string: Change minLength, maxLength, or pattern on the existing VOString. The class body stays empty.
mongo-filter: A Mongo filter is a typed object. Use dot access. Record<string, unknown> and bracket keys fail the check.
empty-function: An action file exports one Command and one const. A local helper is an unexported arrow. The word function fails the check.
read-repo: Leave the read method as EntityReference[]. Shape the HTTP body in the REST index. Do not copy the seed into the read repository.
session-deny: A denial names a wrong path. Edit a file the session lists. Do not edit .cellix/sessions to widen that list.
